title: refactor(git): push preview and push share one Target
body: Land commit 035e9d1 (branch card/7rh2p1), already written and tested; 7rh2p1 is Done so it can't be re-integrated. Only job: git cherry-pick 035e9d1 onto your branch, change its 'Card: 7rh2p1' trailer to this card's id (git commit --amend, message otherwise unchanged), run cargo test --target-dir target/agent (all must pass) and cargo fmt --check, then integrate and wait as your close-out says. Do not change the code; if the pick conflicts or a test fails, block with the reason.
